# Checks the Analyze workflow's cppcheck job does not report, for the whole
# library. A false positive at one place is suppressed there instead, with
# a "cppcheck-suppress" comment giving the reason.

# Parameters taken by value on purpose: sinks that are moved from, and small
# types that are cheap to copy.
passedByValue

# Plain aggregates, filled in where they are made.
uninitMemberVarNoCtor

# Derived DSP types wrap or replace their base's operator() and setters on
# purpose.
duplInheritedMember

# Members set after construction, before any read: the biquad coefficients
# by each derived filter's init(), message data by the derived message,
# wav_memory's first_read by its own constructor, the sysex buffer as bytes
# arrive, the patcher's operators by compile().
uninitMemberVar:*q_lib/include/q/fx/biquad.hpp
uninitDerivedMemberVar:*q_lib/include/q/midi/messages.hpp
uninitMemberVar:*q_io/src/audio_file.cpp
uninitMemberVar:*q_io/src/midi_stream.cpp
uninitMemberVar:*q_lib/include/q/synth/fm/dx_patcher.hpp

# Branches discarded by if constexpr, which cppcheck evaluates anyway.
negativeContainerIndex:*q_lib/include/q/fx/fast_downsample.hpp
containerOutOfBounds:*q_lib/include/q/fx/fast_downsample.hpp
returnTempReference:*q_lib/include/q/midi/endpoint.hpp

# A pick passes on the reference it was given, to the picker's own info.
returnDanglingLifetime:*q_lib/include/q/fx/peak_picker.hpp

# The #error branch for compilers Q does not support.
preprocessorErrorDirective:*q_lib/include/q/detail/count_bits.hpp

# The buffer is std::byte*, not void*.
arithOperationsOnVoidPointer:*q_lib/include/q/utility/ring_allocator.hpp
